principle: Elastic chunk templates define the authored bounds for generated pacing content. They are not narrative beats — they cannot set major story flags. Each template references a plateau, a chunk category, and a socket profile.

templates.notes: Atmosphere and lore texture before the arena. Masks hang in rows; some wear familiar faces. May reference siren_fragment lore tablets. Must not reveal Siren identity or trigger reveal cinematic.
Tension-builder feeding toward the scripted collapse. Narrow geometry, mask hazards, praise whispers from VEIL_ILLUSION. Must not resolve the Siren reveal; that is AUTHORED_CRITICAL only.
Loop and isolation pacing. Player feels the circularity of the space — corridors that lead back. Emotionally reinforces the stagnation and false-praise trap without advancing the critical route.
